about: Aggregate results of the two IE Pro studies (2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17). Aggregates only: no bar data, no per-symbol or per-label output (the bars are TradingView data licensed for personal use and stay on the author's machine). Fractions, not percent. Research only; not advice.

study_1_daily_labels.question: Do the indicator's daily A-grade CONFIRMED labels work (target before stop) more often than an ordinary day?
study_1_daily_labels.engine: TradingView's own server computing the indicator on a hidden chart session; parity check 70 of 70 labels reproduced on a test symbol

prereg_letter.note: [mean, lo, hi], 95% calendar-week bootstrap. By the letter of its verdict rule, A longs passed.

stop_geometry.note: the same-year version was exploratory on 10-16 and used the yardstick later shown to be biased; the whole-history version is the 10-17 correction

why_the_letter_was_wrong.R_tested_against_zero: the rule tested mean R against 0 while its own luck-line section said the ordinary day decides; random-day longs earned +0.29 R in a market that rose 2002-2026

corrected_2026_10_17.method: same symbol's ordinary days over its whole history, label days of any grade excluded, stop distance matched, calendar-month bootstrap
corrected_2026_10_17.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED, every grade; 'A is worse than a random day' withdrawn

study_2_bounce_holdout.question: After an A or A+ SHORT label, buy the next open and sell 20 trading days later: does the stock beat its own ordinary days?

reviewer.agent: prereg-reviewer (read-only tools; barred from the holdout folder)

same_question_four_ways.label: first method (same-stock same-year yardstick), discovery charts
same_question_four_ways.note: entered at the signal close, calendar-week clusters (the v1 draft); from the next open it is +1.75%

same_question_four_ways.label: first method on SHUFFLED prices (nothing to find)
same_question_four_ways.note: range over 10 shuffles, not a 95% interval

same_question_four_ways.label: corrected method, 408 FRESH stocks = the test

freeze.scored: 2026-10-17 ~10:30 PT, after all five hashes checked
